# Pull Request

## Summary
Describe the problem, proposed solution, and user impact. Link the relevant issue.

## Change type
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Security hardening
- [ ] Refactoring
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tests or CI
- [ ] Build/deployment

## Implementation details
Explain important decisions and affected frontend, backend, database, and realtime components.

## Security and privacy
- [ ] Authentication is applied where required.
- [ ] Resource ownership and role authorization are enforced.
- [ ] Client-supplied identity is not trusted.
- [ ] Uploads are validated and downloads are authorized.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or private user data are included.
- [ ] Logs do not expose sensitive values.

## Data and compatibility
- [ ] Mongoose model changes are documented.
- [ ] Existing records and migrations are considered.
- [ ] API response and error behavior is documented.
- [ ] Socket.IO event changes are documented.
- [ ] Environment variable changes are documented.

## Validation
- [ ] Frontend production build completed.
- [ ] Relevant lint checks were run and status reported accurately.
- [ ] Backend syntax checks passed.
- [ ] Relevant HTTP and realtime flows were tested.
- [ ] Unauthorized and malformed requests were tested.
- [ ] Upload and privacy behavior was checked where relevant.

## Evidence
Include commands, test output, and screenshots for UI changes. Clearly state any skipped checks.

## Risks and follow-up
List remaining limitations, deployment changes, and follow-up work. Do not describe unimplemented behavior as complete.
